items.explanation: 有毒 is the adjective form needed here; 是毒 is not the correct form.
想 can take the clause 灵芝会帮他. 知道 is extra here, so delete it.
It would be more natural to say 不会 to show that Lingzhi will not help him.
The giving action is completed in the story, so it takes 了completed.
我们 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
It would be more natural to delete 已经, because 吃了 already shows the action is completed.
